task_completion_rate.description: Completed tasks / tasks explicitly eligible to complete under the supplied authority and fixture state.

automatic_recovery_success_rate.description: Tasks completed by automatic recovery / tasks where automatic recovery was attempted.

duplicate_call_task_rate.description: Tasks with more than one submitted Call request / tasks with at least one submitted Call request.

duplicate_charge_task_rate.description: Tasks with more than one distinct charge-bearing final settlement / tasks with at least one charge-bearing final settlement.

review_settlement_rate.description: Submitted Call tasks ending in review_settlement / submitted Call tasks ending in any settlement recovery action.

missing_execution_id_rate.description: Non-rejected submitted Call attempts without execution_id / non-rejected submitted Call attempts.

final_settlement_evidence_coverage.description: Non-rejected submitted Call tasks with at least one final Usage/Ledger outcome / non-rejected submitted Call tasks.
